name: Kimama Half Moon
description_short: The US location of the Israeli camp organization Camp Kimama, on a lake property in the Berkshires of Massachusetts. Sessions run in July and August for ages 6-17, with day camp and sleepaway options and activities such as waterskiing, wakeboarding and woodshed.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp is set on a lake on the property; waterskiing and wakeboarding are offered. Swim instruction and lifeguard details are not stated.

warnings: This is an overview page with no session dates or prices; the linked Dates & Rates page (kimamahalfmoon.org/datesrates2026) is for 2026, a season that has already ended. No 2027 information is shown.
season_year is set to 2026 only because the site's menu and links mention 2026; the page doesn't tie this program to a specific year.
The page offers both a Day Camp and a Sleepaway Camp (the URL says 'night camp'), so camp_type is left blank.
The page says 'launch of our home in the USA', so this may be a new program with a short track record.
